audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer showed 'Skill' at Level 6, First item and 2+ items while the content layer showed Twisted Fate, Aurelion Sol, Aurelion Sol.
audit.why: Three rows rendered two different answers to the same question. The packet chart (Twisted Fate 1-5, Aurelion Sol 6-7) matches the content layer and the 50.86% owner win rate over 875 games.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side = Twisted Fate, phases[5].side = Aurelion Sol, phases[6].side = Aurelion Sol.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entire content layer describes a version of Aurelion Sol that no longer exists — 'Starsurge', 'stars', 'Comet of Legend', 'dash charges'.
audit.why: His current kit is Stardust (P), Breath of Light (Q, 3s), Astral Flight (W, 22/20.5/19/17.5/16), the black hole (E, 12s) and Falling Star / The Skies Descend (R, 120/110/100). None of the named abilities exist, so every spike timing on the page is described with fabricated tools. Twisted Fate's spikes are Pick a Card (6s) from level 1 and Destiny at 6 on 170/140/110.
audit.corrected: Rewrote whys, spikes, early, mid, late and wants around the real kit: stardust banking, the black-hole execute clear, Astral Flight, and Falling Star at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that gold card cancels Aurelion Sol's channels.
audit.why: Breath of Light (Q) and Astral Flight (W) are both interruptible channels. Pick a Card (W, flat 6s) is his only hard CC and it also resets his auto-attack, so the gold card ends the beam and can drop him out of flight. Wild Cards is a 10000-range projectile with no CC, so his poke alone cannot break a channel. Destiny reveals but does not disable, and Astral Flight flies over terrain, so it beats his Gate positioning on approach lines.
audit.corrected: Never start a beam while his card is locked gold; treat a spent card as the six-second window.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns is a template, and the packet flags zero sequencing advice on this matchup.
audit.why: Pick a Card is a flat 6s, Wild Cards 6 down to 5s, Destiny 170/140/110, Astral Flight 22s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with a concrete wait-for-X line on the gold card.

audit.why: Pick a Card is W, not Q, and it resets his auto-attack rather than his Q; blue card restores mana. Wild Cards is the Q poke.
audit.corrected: Split correctly across the rewritten spikes and wants entries.

edits.after: - Pick a Card is a flat 6s and gold is his only hard CC — wait until the card is spent before you start a beam, then you have six seconds. - Wild Cards drops to 5s and never opens a window; ignore it as a tell. - Destiny is 170s at rank 1: track it and roam on the downtime.

edits.before: If Twisted Fate opens the score, reset expectations and respect Pick a Card (Gold) doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with E executes and stay relevant through the stardust curve.
edits.after: If Twisted Fate opens the score, expect Destiny to turn it into two more lanes — ping the reveal and follow with Teleport. After a second kill, stop contesting: clear with the black hole and keep banking stardust.

notes: This matchup's content layer described the pre-rework Aurelion Sol throughout — 'Starsurge', 'Comet of Legend', 'stars', 'dash charges'. None of those are in his kit; it is Breath of Light, Astral Flight, the black hole and Falling Star / The Skies Descend. Every affected string was rewritten. Also fixed 'blue card (Q reset)' — Pick a Card is W and resets his auto-attack, blue restores mana, Wild Cards is the Q poke. Three level-chart disagreements at Level 6, First item and 2+ items were fixed as a group against the packet chart. Whether gold card's stun is cleanse/QSS-able or shortened by tenacity is not in Riot's text and was not asserted.
